subject: Type II report access and evidence roadmap
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@medinova.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + ask: SOC 2 Type II access, bridge letter, and vendor QA

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the security/compliance asks from your procurement team: 

- What you asked for: access to Redwood's latest SOC 2 Type II report (and a bridge letter if available), answers to the short vendor security questionnaire, and confirmation on GDPR/HIPAA handling.
- What we can provide: a hosted, redacted SOC 2 Type II report (or full report via secure trust portal), a short bridge letter confirming scope for calendar year 2025–2026, and a completed vendor questionnaire.

Action items I propose (happy to adjust):
1) Please confirm the best email address to provision for portal access (we can invite a single user for initial review). We recommend using a compliance-specific account (e.g., security@medinova.com).
2) If Medinova requires an LOA/NDA before a full report is shared, tell us the contact and we will route to Legal.
3) I attached our short vendor security questionnaire to reduce back-and-forth — if you prefer, we can fill your questionnaire instead.
4) Redwood will prepare a bridge-letter draft and a redacted report export and share via your vendor portal or DocuSign link by next Friday (Dec 7) if portal access is available.

Proposed timeline: portal invite by 12/03 so you can review before your procurement deadline; full report/bridge letter shared by 12/07. Can we schedule a 20-minute sync on 12/08 to confirm any outstanding items?

Thanks — I’ll also loop in Marcus and Evelyn on the bridge letter and redaction plan.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Questionnaire_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@medinova.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Medinova Security Team <security@medinova.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Recap + ask: SOC 2 Type II access, bridge letter, and vendor QA

Dylan —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few notes from our side after internal procurement/security sync: 

- Portal account: please invite security@medinova.com for initial review. We will create a vendor-only account and share read-only access.
- Full report: procurement prefers a redacted copy first; the legal team will request an LOA if they need the unredacted file.
- Bridge letter: yes, we need a signed bridge letter that specifies the covered period and attestations.
- Questionnaire: happy for you to complete ours instead of reworking yours — attaching our onboarding form.

Timeline we can meet: portal invite by 12/04, redacted report by 12/07, final bridge letter and LOA handling the following week if needed. If you can send a DocuSign for the bridge letter draft, we’ll route to Legal quickly.

Two quick questions for you before portal invite: who should I expect the invite from (name + email)? we need that for our identity checks. Also, does Redwood keep full audit logs for vendor access (view/download timestamps)?

Thanks,
Sarah Miller
Head of Procurement
Medinova Health

Attachments: Medinova_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Draft bridge letter + redaction plan (internal)

Dylan / Evelyn —

Following Sarah's reply, here’s my recommended approach so we can move fast and avoid legal churn: 

1) I’ll draft a short bridge letter that states scope (SOC 2 Type II, Security + Availability controls, audit period Jan 1–Dec 31 2025) and includes an explicit note that full report access requires an LOA. Keep it to a single page.
2) Evelyn — can you prepare a redacted export of the Type II report with sensitive control-owner names and specific IP redacted? We should mark any redactions clearly so their legal team sees we’re not withholding evidence, just protecting PII.
3) I'll prepare a DocuSign envelope for the bridge letter and share the envelope link for Dylan to send to Sarah. I’ll also pre-fill the portal invite to security@medinova.com from redwood-compliance@redwoodinference.com so they see the legit sender.
4) Audit log answer: yes — the portal records view/download events, timestamps, and the invite origin. I’ll include a short export template so Medinova knows what to expect.

Plan to have drafts back to Dylan by COB 12/04.

-Marcus
Head of Trust & Compliance (acting)
Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@medinova.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Type II report access and evidence roadmap — portal invite + DocuSign

Sarah —

Thanks for the fast responses. Quick update and what I sent your way: 

- Portal invite: I invited security@medinova.com from redwood-compliance@redwoodinference.com. You should receive an automated VendorTrust invite from vendortrust@redwood-vendor.com with the subject "Medinova — Redwood Inference vendor access". If you don’t see it, check spam and I can resend.
- Bridge letter: Marcus uploaded a one-page bridge-letter draft to the DocuSign envelope and I sent it to the main procurement contact listed on your onboarding form. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/envelope/0a1b2c (expires 7 days).
- Redacted report: Evelyn uploaded a redacted Type II PDF to the portal share (filename: SOC2-Redwood-TypeII-Redacted-2025.pdf). The portal records will show any downloads or views — you can request an audit export if Legal wants one.
- Questionnaire: I started filling your onboarding form but attached our vendor questionnaire as well in case it helps with specific technical controls.

Next steps: 
- Please confirm once you accept the portal invite and sign the bridge letter (or let us know if Legal needs changes).
- I’ll hold a 20-minute sync on 12/08 at 10:00 AM PT; if that works, I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks again — let me know if we should route anything to Legal first.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: Bridge_Letter_Draft_Dec2026.docx, SOC2-Redwood-TypeII-Redacted-2025.pdf (available in portal)
